main_text.p: rium in cæteros obtinuit Rex Calecuti, dictus Zamorus i.e Imperator: cui subjecta erant minora regna Cochin, Canonor, Baticola, Chala, Onor & Culon, cum aliis minoribus quibusdam.
main_text.head: REGNA NAR-SINGÆ.
Canon.
main_text.p: 3[?]Regna Narsingæ præci-pua sunt: Negapatan, Maliapur, Bisnagar, Orixa.
main_text.head: Explicatio:
main_text.p: Quem tractum Nautæ vulgò vo-cant Choromandel, & is complectitur regna Narsinga, quæ etiam Bisnagar appellantur. Regis Narsingæ tanta perhibetur esse potentia, ut regnum ejus vix intra sex menses circumiri possit.

page.notes: The margin mark beside the heading "REGNA NARSINGÆ" is a small "3" followed by a dot; it is uncertain whether it is a number or a section mark. The left edge of the scan shows the facing page's text, and faint show-through is visible in the centre; neither is transcribed. The catchword "RE-" is the start of the next page.
